title: SWF audio: DefineSound SampleCount hardcoded to 0 — looping sounds broken
description:
In packages/swf/src/audio.ts around line 102, sampleCount is hardcoded to 0 with a 'MVP' comment. Ruffle uses SampleCount to determine loop boundaries for sounds with LoopCount>1 — when sampleCount=0, loop repetition silently misbehaves.

Fix: compute the real sample count from the SoundItem model. The model likely exposes durationSeconds and sampleRate. Compute:
  const sampleCount = Math.round((item.durationSeconds ?? 0) * (item.sampleRate ?? 44100))

Check the actual SoundItem type definition (search for 'SoundItem' in packages/core/src/model) to find the correct field names.

Also check: if durationSeconds is not available in the model, check if the raw audio buffer length is available to compute it from (totalSamples = buffer.length / (channels * bytesPerSample)).

Run tests after: pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run AND pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run (must stay at current counts).
Commit: fix(audio): compute real DefineSound SampleCount instead of hardcoding 0
